title: TransportOrderRejected
description: The TMS rejected a booking because it breaks one or more Transport Order rules (Canonical Model event, version 1). Published on the Transport Order events topic. A rejected booking has no Transport Order number.

transportOrderId.description: The TMS's ID for the rejected booking, under which Customer service can look it up.

shipperId.description: The Shipper the booking named. It may be one the TMS doesn't know (reason UnknownShipper).

shipperReference.description: The Shipper's own reference for the booking, when it gave one.

reasons.description: Every Transport Order rule the booking broke.

code.description: A stable rejection code, such as GoodsLinesMissing. The codes are listed in the P1 process document.
